title: fix(plugin-list,components,i18n): list filter starts on the first visible column, hides hidden fields, one empty check where empty and null match the same records (objectui#11810)
body:
Fixes #11810
Clause-②: yes

The claim was amended to `Clause-②: yes` in comment 6048182477, because the two new language-pack keys below widen `@object-ui/i18n`'s published packs. Implemented by the dispatched dev on this branch, session `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.

## What changes

**List view (`@object-ui/plugin-list`, `ListView`'s `filterFields`).** The Filter panel's field list was the object definition's field map verbatim, and the served map puts the injected system columns first. Now:

- a field the definition marks `hidden: true` (`organization_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, the `__search` companion) is not offered, unless the view names it in `filterableFields` or a condition the panel already holds filters on it (a filter restored from the per-user cache, possibly saved while "Add filter" still defaulted to Organization; without this its field trigger would draw blank);
- order: the view's columns as the grid shows them (`effectiveFields`: after FLS, user-hidden columns and `fieldOrder`), then the other business fields, then system fields (the shared `isSystemManagedField` from `@object-ui/types`, which reads the spec's `system` flag), then a hidden field kept by the rule above. The definition's own order holds inside a tier.
- "Add filter" seeds a row on the list's first entry (`addCondition` reads the first entry of `fields`), so a new condition now starts on the view's first visible column. No default is chosen anywhere else.

**Builder (`@object-ui/components`, `FilterBuilder`).** The operator dropdown mounts `offeredOperatorsForRow` (module-private): `operatorsForFieldType` minus `is_null` / `is_not_null` on a column whose type the spec's `expandEmptyOperator` rates `null_only`. The row's own operator is always mounted, so a stored `is_null` still loads as "Is null". `operatorsForFieldType` (what a row can HOLD) is unchanged.

**Hint (`@object-ui/components` + `@object-ui/i18n`).** Where both pairs stay, the operator list ends with one line saying how they differ. The operator labels are interpolated, not restated.

## The per-type table

Read from `@objectstack/spec` `expandEmptyOperator` (17.7.0), the function every server face expands `$empty` with. Not a local list.

| arm | types (by `type` alone) | "Is empty" matches | offered | hint |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `null_only` | number, currency, percent, date, datetime, time, boolean, toggle, select, radio, lookup, master_detail, tree, user, image, file, avatar, video, audio, formula, summary, autonumber, composite, repeater, record, location, address, json, rating, slider, progress, vector, and any unknown type | null only (exactly what "Is null" matches) | "Is empty" / "Is not empty" only | none |
| `text` | text, textarea, email, url, phone, password, secret, markdown, html, richtext, code, color, signature, qrcode | null or `''` | both pairs | "Is empty" also matches blank text; "Is null" matches only a missing value |
| `multi_value` | multiselect, checkboxes, tags | null or `[]` | both pairs | "Is empty" also matches an empty list; "Is null" matches only a missing value |

The pair that stays on `null_only` is `is_empty` / `is_not_empty`: every bucket that has an empty check offers it, so one label means one thing across columns, and every dialect the builder writes lowers it to `$empty` (Mongo criteria in `FilterConditionField`, `ViewFilterRule` in saved views and the dataset inspector, the AST `isempty` in the live grid).

## Callers of `FilterBuilder`

- `plugin-list` `ListView` (end-user list toolbar): field list, order and default change here; operator offer as above.
- `fields` `FilterConditionField` (sharing-rule criteria): offer narrows the same way. It loses no predicate: on a `null_only` column `{ $empty: true }` matches what `{ $null: true }` matches. A stored `$null` reads back as `is_null` and stays mounted.
- `app-shell` dataset inspector and `metadata-admin` widgets, `config-field-renderer`, the SDUI `filter-builder` renderer: same offer change. The dataset read-back (`builderHolds`, `readBackOperator`) asks `operatorsForFieldType`, which is unchanged, so a stored `$null` on a select column stays editable in the visual builder. Control: the `datasetFilterCondition*` suites pass unchanged.

## Public surface

No export, prop or type member is added. `@object-ui/components` raises its `@objectstack/spec` floor from `^17.0.0` to `^17.5.0`, because its published entry now imports `expandEmptyOperator`, which the spec first exports in 17.5.0 (`pnpm-lock.yaml` moves only that importer's specifier line). `offeredOperatorsForRow`, `emptyCheckArm` and the hint renderer are module-private. Two NEW language-pack keys in all ten packs: `filterBuilder.emptyCheckHint.text` and `filterBuilder.emptyCheckHint.list`.

Changeset `.changeset/11810-filter-builder-fields.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` `minor` (the added keys, as in objectui#11645), `@object-ui/components` `minor` (it ships the hint that reads them), `@object-ui/plugin-list` `patch` (its part is a fix). All three are in the `fixed` group, so they are versioned together at the group's highest level, `minor`. `pnpm exec changeset status` lists the group at `minor`, with no mixed-changeset error.

## Tests

Head `24a52a4`. All runs go from the worktree root through the shared verify lock. The code union below ran on `3c5fe54`. Since then no source file has changed: `78fb73b` sets the changeset levels, and `24a52a4` raises `@object-ui/components`' `@objectstack/spec` floor (`git diff --stat 78fb73b 24a52a4`: the `package.json` range, the `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer specifier line, one changeset sentence).

The run still exits 1, but only for 14 `no-artifact` findings: packages this branch does not touch and that were not built locally (app-shell, auth, cli, layout, plugin-chatbot, plugin-dashboard, plugin-designer, plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-gantt, plugin-grid, plugin-timeline, plugin-tree, plugin-view). Marginal cost measured instead: `@objectstack/spec/data` is already in the eager closure through `renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`isFileIdToken`), and an esbuild probe of that import with and without `expandEmptyOperator` moves 641429 to 641645 bytes minified (+216), 152073 to 152167 gzip (+94).

### Pins

- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.filterFieldList-11810.test.tsx` — the Tasks definition rebuilt from the spec's `injectedSystemColumnDefs`, `task.object.ts`'s declared fields and the `__search` companion (25 fields, lit control): no hidden field; order columns, then business fields, then system fields; "Add filter" starts on "Title"; `fieldOrder` is followed; a held condition on `organization_id` keeps it last and its trigger reads "Organization"; `filterableFields` naming a hidden field keeps it.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-empty-null-pair-11810.test.tsx` — the arm table read from the spec (lit control); nine `null_only` types offer one pair and no hint; text types offer both pairs and the blank-text hint; list types both pairs and the empty-list hint; a stored `is_null` on a select shows "Is null" (control); a stored camelCase `isNotNull` loads; a text row on "Is null" switched to a select keeps it; `operatorsForFieldType` still carries both pairs (author-facing callers' hold set, control).
- `filter-builder-operator-alias-trigger-7561.test.tsx`: the recorded number-column list loses "Is null" / "Is not null". `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: the census moves 71 to 75 for the hint's four quoted spans.

### Ablations (one-off, committed tree, restored by `git checkout HEAD --`, restore proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

Direction predicted before each run: red.

1. `filterFields` returns `candidateFields` unfiltered: 5 of 6 field-list pins red, the fixture control green. "Add filter" reads `Organization` instead of `Title`, the issue's symptom.
2. `offeredOperatorsForRow` returns the full bucket: 11 red (the nine `null_only` types, the stored-`is_null` partner check, the 7561 recorded list), 52 green.
3. The row-own clause removed: the three stored/held-operator controls red, each with a BLANK trigger (expected 'Is null', received '').

The first attempt at ablation 1 was a no-op: the landing check counted a multi-line anchor with `grep -cF` (one pattern per line) and refused before any test ran. It was re-run with a single-line anchor and a marker count (0 to 1) as the landing proof.

## Acceptance notes

- **`multiple: true` lookups / users / selects.** The builder's field descriptor carries `type` only, so such a column is judged by its type (`null_only`) and offered "Is empty" / "Is not empty" without the null pair. On the server it is `multi_value`, and "Is empty" there matches null or `[]`, which is the reading an end user means. Offering both pairs with the list hint there would need `multiple` on the descriptor, a new type member. Not done here.
- **A system field that is one of the view's columns** sorts with the columns, in column order: the author put it in the view, and the list mirrors the grid. The "system fields last" tier is the system fields the view does not show.
- **Hidden fields that stay listed**: one named in `filterableFields` (the spec calls it "fields enabled for end-user filtering", an explicit author choice), and one a held condition filters on (otherwise its field trigger draws blank). Both go last.
- **Sort picker, not measured.** The Sort popover reads the same `candidateFields` (relational fields excluded, the platform's sortability signal applied). Whether it offers the hidden `__search` text column on a served deployment was not measured. Carrier: none.
